about: New and planned content for Cargo 1. Every node here is a draft until the game reads it. The two echoes below are examples of the format, not decided story.

heard_the_warning.about: the captain listened to their future self at the portal

met_the_stranger.about: the captain met the old hauler at an outpost

echo.portal.title: A voice from the portal
echo.portal.text: The portal's light resolves into a ship you know: your own hull, older, patched where you have not patched it yet. Its captain has your voice.

variants.text: {visitor.name}, {visitor.rank}, hails you from the far side of the saga.

echo.outpost.title: The old hauler at the outpost
echo.outpost.text: At the outpost bar an old hauler pays for your drink and will not say why. She knows the name of your ship.

variants.text: The hauler wears {visitor.name}'s face, decades on. She does not let you finish the thought.
